Minutes of the Annual General Meeting (fictional)

Harbourview Strata Corporation, held March 12, 2026 at 7:00 p.m.

1. Call to order

The meeting was called to order at 7:04 p.m. by the council president. Owners of 38 strata lots were present in person and 11 by proxy, for 49 of 60 lots, so a quorum was confirmed.

2. Approval of the 2026 budget

The owners reviewed the proposed operating budget of $463,100, an increase of 6.8% over 2025, mainly from the insurance premium of $118,500. The vote on the resolution was as follows:

VoteLots
In favour41
Opposed5
Abstained3

The resolution carried by majority vote.

3. Depreciation report

The council presented the 2025 depreciation report. The report recommends raising the contingency reserve fund to $1.2 million by 2030 and replacing the roof membrane in 2028 at an estimated cost of $640,000.

4. Special levy for the parkade membrane

A 3/4 vote resolution to approve a special levy of $185,000, payable by June 30, 2026 and apportioned by unit entitlement, was carried with 44 in favour, 4 opposed and 1 abstention.

5. Election of council

Five owners were elected to council for a one-year term.

6. Adjournment

The meeting adjourned at 8:51 p.m.
